source_title: Whirlpool WRX986SIHZ product page (Water Filter EDR2RXD1)
filter_location_text: Whirlpool WRX986SIHZ uses an interior everydrop Filter 2 cartridge on this 4-door French-door platform.
replacement_steps_summary: Whirlpool support guidance for EDR2RXD1: remove the old filter cartridge, install the new everydrop Filter 2 until locked, flush water, then reset the filter indicator when prompted.
cautions: Whirlpool recommends genuine everydrop filters; non-genuine filters may not be covered under warranty.
notes: Tier 1 Whirlpool bundle for WRX986SIHZ — product page Filter Details lists Water Filter Part Number EDR2RXD1; Owner's Center recommends EDR2RXD1.
